Second test cohort for the central acceptance test, written by
tests/fixtures/make_central_fixture.sh. Genotypes: 120 unrelated 1000 Genomes
high-coverage samples (60 EUR, 60 EAS) not in tests/fixtures/site or the PCA panel,
chr22 variants of the first cohort, with SYNTHETIC imputation R2 and dosage noise.
Phenotypes, QC metrics, cell proportions and covariates: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE FIXTURES
with the planted effects of tests/fixtures/site/TRUTH.tsv (other random seeds).
Not biological data. T121 is a technical replicate; T122 has no genotypes; T017 has
scrambled expression.
